source: Trim, Braaten, Lie & Tognarelli (2005), Journal of Fluids and Structures 21(3), 335-361 (the rig, Sec. 2.1; Figs. 16 and 18); Fontaine, Marcollo, Vandiver, Triantafyllou, Larsen, Tognarelli, Constantinides & Oakley (2011), OMAE2011, Vol. 7, 511-522 (Table 1, the riser); Thorsen, Saevik & Larsen (2016), Journal of Fluids and Structures 61, 1-19 (Table 1, Eq. 1, Figs. 4, 7 and 8); Ulveseter, Thorsen, Saevik & Larsen (2019), Applied Ocean Research 90, 101856 (Tables 1 and 3, Sec. 4.1); Andersen, Saevik, Wu, Leira & Langseth (2024b), Applied Ocean Research 153, 104284 (Table 3); Ulveseter, Thorsen, Saevik & Larsen (2018), Marine Structures 60, 241-260 (Table 3); Chaplin, Bearman, Huera Huarte & Pattenden (2005), Journal of Fluids and Structures 21(1), 3-24 (Eq. 4)
bibliographic_data: volumes, issues and pages from Crossref (api.crossref.org), 2026-11-16
data_used: riser: 38.00 m between universal joints, OD 27 mm, EI 598.8 N m^2, EA 8.19e6 N, 0.933 kg/m water-filled, mass ratio 1.62 (Fontaine et al. 2011, Table 1); tension 4-6 kN over the tests (Trim et al. 2005, Sec. 2.1); the maximum r.m.s. cross-flow strain of the 22 uniform-flow tests, fundamental and total, and Thorsen et al.'s simulation (Thorsen et al. 2016, Fig. 8a; the sheared panel is extracted but not compared); Thorsen et al.'s fitted Cv(y0/D) (Fig. 7); the spatial mean sigma/D, CF and IL, at 22 speeds (Trim et al. 2005, Fig. 16, bare riser, uniform flow); the peak frequency of the dominant displacement mode, CF and IL, at 0.3, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0 and 2.4 m/s (Fig. 18)
extraction: Thorsen et al. (2016) Figs. 7 and 8 are vector graphics: extract_thorsen2016.py maps the plotted coordinates through the plot frames (axis ends at the tick labels: 0-2.5 m/s and 0-5e-4 for Fig. 8a; y0/D 0-1 and Cv 0-1.5 for Fig. 7); 22 points per series. Trim et al. (2005) Figs. 16 and 18 are raster images with overlapping markers: read by eye on 4x enlarged crops with a guide at every speed and every 0.01 / 1 Hz, drawn by digitise_trim2005.py after calibrating the axes on the panel frames and grid lines; +-0.01 in sigma/D (about +-0.02 where neighbouring markers overlap), +-0.3 Hz (+-0.5 Hz for CF at 2.0 m/s)
assumptions: fresh water 1000 kg/m^3 (the mass ratio 1.62 implies 1006 kg/m^3); the rig as an axial spring in series with the riser, T0 4 kN in still water, k_ax 3.5 kN/m derived from the reported 4-6 kN range with Morison drag at Cd 1.2 at 2.4 m/s (not tuned to the response); the riser 5 m below the surface in 10 m of water (not given; the current is uniform); Ca 1; VIVrmsWindow 0.5 s

coefficients.b1: the generic set of the Delta Flume case, nothing fitted to the NDP tests: Cl 0.8, cF 0.18, dF 0.08, Cd 1.2; VIV ClX 0.85, alpha 0.15 (Ulveseter et al. 2018, Table 3); VIV AMPLITUDE Cv 0.8 with CdAmp = 1 + 2.3 s + 1.7 s^2, s = (A/D)/sqrt(2), at A/D 0-1.5 (Chaplin et al. 2005, Eq. 4); VIV DAMPING 0 0 1
coefficients.and24b: Andersen et al. (2024b), Table 3, cross-flow average of the per-case optima for the 22 sheared-flow NDP tests: Cl 1.28, cF 0.131, dF 0.066, Cd 1.16, Ca 1.0; their in-line set (Cv,x 1.09, f0,x 0.321, df,x 0.161) left out
coefficients.uls19: Ulveseter et al. (2019), Table 1, fitted by them to these uniform-flow tests (Sec. 4.1): Cd 1.2, CM 2, Cl 0.85, cF 0.144, dF 0.064; VIV ClX 0.75, alpha 0.15, Chh 1.5
coefficients.th16: Thorsen et al. (2016), fitted by them to the 22 uniform and 22 sheared NDP tests: VIV AMPLITUDE with the Fig. 7 Cv curve (thorsen2016_fig7_cv.csv), VIV DAMPING 0.31 0.89 0 (Eq. 1), band 0.18 +- 0.08 for the 0.10-0.26 range of Fig. 4; Cd 1.2
coefficients.th16c: th16 with VIV DAMPING 0.31 0.89 1 (Morison's linear cross-flow damping kept): a variant

CableDyn_commit: 041337e (dev) with the mid-point VIV phase update (fix/viv-coupled-order)

sensitivity.note: fundamental strain [-], dominant CF frequency [Hz], spatial-mean CF sigma/D and mean tension [N] at the given speeds, against response_comparison.csv; tmax_55: 55 s runs, statistics over 45 s
